interpretation: Only last-card Defend with no potions, powers or unqualified relics. The comparator is immediate End Turn at the same frozen concrete state/RNG. This is not a public-state pruning rule or a frequency estimate for all wasted block. Q uses heuristic units; a 1e-6 near-equality threshold is descriptive, not statistical significance. Unused-energy scoring and loop-guard headroom differences are recorded separately.
